notes: Printed names: W. McMILLAN ('West McMillan Street'), OHIO AV., CLIFF (NOT OPEN), VAN LEAR (printed twice, on both legs), MILK, FITT ALLEY, VINE, HOLLISTER, SCIOTO (on the 262 margin north of McMillan); suffix-less names written with 'Street'. Ohio crosses McMillan (continues north onto 260, which also names it Ohio Avenue); its lines flare at McMillan and the north part sits ~15 ft west of the south part, point is the middle of the open crossing. Cliff (25') starts at McMillan (T) and runs south onto 244; Van Lear (30') starts at Cliff's east side (T) about 145 ft south of McMillan. Milk (40') runs from McMillan SE to Vine (T both ends); sheet 189's unnamed '?' 40 ft street leaving Vine to the NW is this Milk Street. Fitt Alley (14' at McMillan, 15' further down, narrowing to ~4' at its foot) runs from McMillan SE to Vine (T both ends). Scioto comes down from 262 and ends at McMillan's north side; it sits just across McMillan from the mouth of Fitt Alley (centrelines ~55 px apart at McMillan's centre), recorded as two T points. Vine (about 60-65 ft as drawn) runs SSW down the right side; its east side is the Volume 2 area ('SEE VOLUME TWO'), and Hollister comes in from there and ends at Vine (T; sheet 189 has the same Hollister/Vine junction). The McMillan/Vine junction is at the top-right corner, but Vine's centre there falls on the binding at the page edge (x~6480), so it is not recorded. Three unnamed alleys in block 4 (in alleys): a N-S one (12' at McMillan, 15' in the middle, 12' at its foot) from McMillan SSW to Fitt Alley, and a 15' one from Fitt Alley east, crossing it, then ESE to Vine (two segments). A fourth unnamed 15' alley runs from Van Lear ESE to Vine near the bottom (y~6450-6840); it also shows at the top of 244. Lyon's junction with Ohio shows on the 241 overlap at the left edge and is recorded on 241 only. Circled figures are grade elevations; the lot line at y~3000 between Cliff and Van Lear is not a street.
